description: This file contains CSS styles for theming and component design in a frontend application. It defines variables for light and dark themes, styles for the main App component, header, links, and a button for theme toggling.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main application container that centers its content and applies background and text colors based on the current theme.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header component for the application, styled to occupy the full viewport height and flexibly aligning its child elements.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Link component styled with the secondary theme color and transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button component for toggling between light and dark themes, featuring hover and active effects.
